description: Sign-in required: call connect(email) and connect_verify first (free, one email) unless this connection is already signed in. Read the signed-in account: status, the plan and its limits (everything is free during the beta) and the account's keys by prefix. Changes nothing: to revoke a key call revoke_api_key, to delete the account call request_deletion.

action.description: What to show: `status` (default: who is signed in, the plan and its limits, keys), `plan` (the plan and its limits), `keys` (keys by prefix). To revoke a key call revoke_api_key; to delete the account call request_deletion.
action.title: Action

key_prefix.description: Not used: this tool only reads. To revoke a key call revoke_api_key with the prefix from action=`keys`.
key_prefix.title: Key Prefix

session.description: The `session` value the sign-in returned. Pass it on every call in this conversation, so the sign-in survives however this client handles connections; omit it when the user connected with Sign in (OAuth) or a key.

tier.description: Not needed during the beta: everything is free and there is no paid plan to choose.
tier.title: Tier

name: avokata_account
title: Your account and plan
